_comment: Per-server settings for the org channel commands: /alliance, /alliancevc, /tribe1on1s.
The bot runs in more than one server, so anything server-specific belongs here keyed by guild ID.
To add a server: copy the block below, swap in that server's guild ID and role IDs.
spectator_role — a role that can READ alliance channels but never 1-on-1s, and can't speak in either.
Set it to null (or leave the server out entirely) if that server has no spectator role; the
permission overwrite is then skipped and the commands work normally. A role ID that no longer
exists is also treated as null, so a deleted role can't break channel creation.
category_channel_limit — how many channels /tribe1on1s will put in one category before moving to
the next. Discord's hard cap is 50. Lower it to leave headroom in a category you also use for
something else. Applies to every server unless a guild block overrides it.
